about: Lisa A. Sharpe is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law.

Lisa Sharpe, who practices law in Seattle, Washington, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of San Diego School of Law. She graduated in 1991. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1991.
